# Internal notes

Contributor-facing working notes: architecture write-ups, build records and
punch lists that document how something was built and why.

These are **not** user documentation. Anything a user needs belongs in the
[Maintainerr_docs](https://github.com/Maintainerr/Maintainerr_docs) repository,
published at <https://docs.maintainerr.info>, which is the single source of
truth for product behaviour. Documenting a feature in both places is how the two
drift, so keep user-facing material out of this directory.

Notes here are point-in-time records. They are not kept current the way the
published docs are, so check them against the code before relying on a detail.
